name: talk-field-v
prompt: He talks to the camera in a relaxed, warm voice with natural pauses and small hand gestures, realistic lip sync: "I ask A.I. a hundred small things a day. Every one used to mean a new tab, and losing my place. So I built an app that lives one shortcut away. Command, Shift, Space. Ask. Done. And your chats never leave your Mac." He smiles at the end. Sound: close, clean lavalier-microphone voice, with soft wind and distant ocean waves underneath; no music. Tall grass sways in the wind, the ocean glitters behind him. Locked-off wide shot on a tripod, golden hour, fine film grain, 24 fps, natural motion. No text, no logos.
